# Marten

> .NET Transactional Document DB and Event Store on PostgreSQL

Pragmatic library to boost your developer productivity!

## Table of Contents

### Introduction

- [Introduction](https://martendb.io/introduction.md): Introduction to Marten, the .NET transactional document database and event store built on PostgreSQL with JSONB support, LINQ querying, and full event sourcing.
- [Getting Started](https://martendb.io/getting-started.md): Get started with Marten in your .NET application. Install the NuGet package, configure the document store, and start storing and querying documents in minutes.
- [Support Policy](https://martendb.io/support-policy.md)

### Event Store
